name: Mahou no Milk Tea ni Onegai
original_name: 魔法のミルクティーにお願い
source:
Main character becomes an owner of a tea shop, but he is not really interested in tea. He wants to have intimate relations with girls around. So he adds aphrodisiac to the tea and enjoys company of waitresses and cute clients.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公成为一家茶馆的老板，却对茶本身毫无兴趣。他只想与身边的少女发生亲密关系，于是把春药掺进茶中，享受女服务员和可爱顾客的陪伴。
